narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two times three times four is twenty four, so the sets repeat every twenty four.
<bookmark mark='twelve'/>Twelve is already a multiple of two, of three and of four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Twenty four is not the smallest such number, so that gap is too big.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check a set, divide the first by two, the second by three, and the third by four.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>The gap between sets is the smallest number that two, three and four all divide.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu multiplies two, three and four and says the sets repeat every twenty four. The common multiple that counts is twelve, so a set comes every twelve numbers.
